name: Prospective Unsolved & Orphan Cancers Discovery Cohort (12 Refractory Lineages)
citation: Mackay et al. (2017) Cancer Cell; Howard et al. (2023) Cancer Cell; Tirode et al. (2014) Cancer Discov.; Honeyman et al. (2014) Science; Robertson et al. (2017) Cancer Cell; Tarpey et al. (2017) Nat. Commun.

rules.EZH2: SMARCB1_loss or H3K27M_mut or NF1_PRC2_loss or EWSR1_FLI1_fus
rules.HDAC: H3K27M_mut or EWSR1_FLI1_fus or PAX3_FOXO1_fus or BRD4_NUTM1_fus
rules.BET_BRD4: BRD4_NUTM1_fus or MYB_NFIB_fus or EWSR1_FLI1_fus or PAX3_FOXO1_fus or NF1_PRC2_loss
rules.MEK: NF1_PRC2_loss or PKC or PRKACA or H3K27M_mut or TBXT_amp or Growth_Microenv
rules.PI3K: H3K27M_mut or EWSR1_WT1_fus or TBXT_amp or PAX3_FOXO1_fus or Growth_Microenv
rules.MYC: BET_BRD4 or EZH2 or ERK or mTOR or NOTCH1
rules.CDK9: BET_BRD4 or EWSR1_FLI1_fus or PAX3_FOXO1_fus or MYB_NFIB_fus
rules.CDK4_6: CDKN2A_loss or MYC or PAX3_FOXO1_fus or TBXT_amp
rules.P53: not TP53_mut and not EZH2 and not HDAC and not AKT
rules.MCL1: (CDK9 or ERK or mTOR or MYC or STAT_surv) and not BAX
rules.BCLxL: (YAP_TEAD or PRKACA or AKT or TBXT_amp or HDAC) and not BAX
rules.BCL2: (NOTCH1 or MYB_NFIB_fus or EZH2 or BET_BRD4) and not BAX
rules.BAX: (P53 or not BCL2 or not BCLxL) and not MCL1
rules.Caspase8: Growth_Microenv and (not MCL1 or not BCLxL or not BCL2)
rules.Proliferation: (MYC or CDK4_6 or ERK or mTOR or YAP_TEAD) and not Apoptosis
